{{Quote|Welcome aboard the Stellar Haze, fastest ship on Wielu.|Rook Pryce|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''''Stellar Haze''''' was the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]].<ref name="SC" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Pryce offered to fly [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], along with his prisoner [[T'mott Zoat]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Helleguth]]. Once they boarded his ship, Pryce betrayed Kenobi and set Zoat free in exchange for four hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SC" />
